messages.subject: ESG & Sustainability Executive | Government Relations, External Affairs & Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Talent Nation Team,

Your specialist executive-search focus on ESG, sustainability, climate and purpose-led leadership across Australia and New Zealand makes this a highly relevant introduction. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where sustainability strategy, institutional trust and responsible development are central to performance. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
